title: 2024 Nellai Express cash seizure case: T.N. BJP president Nainar Nagenthran appears before court
description: In April 2024, ₹3.99 crore was seized from three men aboard Nellai Express, at Tambaram. The cash was allegedly being taken for distribution to voters in Tirunelveli following the instruction of Mr. Nagenthran who was contesting in Lok Sabha election
